assessment: This important study provides a new perspective on how human immunity shapes the antigenic evolution of pathogens. By combining theory and simulation the authors make a compelling case for the importance of eco-evolutionary interactions in population-level virus-host dynamics, which arise due to coupling between the dynamics of immune memories and viral variants. Although the work does not propose improved data-driven viral forecasting methods, it makes a conceptual contribution that advances the field's understanding of this problem's intrinsic difficulty.
